subject: shiny server and R3.0 - problems on startup

messages.author: 70abc85dd4bcb117
messages.subject: shiny server and R3.0 - problems on startup
parts:
My R installation autoupgraded to 3.0 which of course caused many problems, but I have RStudio working (after a reinstall) and all of the shiny packages reinstalled so everything works fine from within RStudio.  I can start the shiny-server and I get the index page but when I try to run a Shiny app I get the following error message below.
The actual file mentioned appears to be in that location with appropriate permissions.  I am NOT a linux expert so I am looking for any ideas on what I should try next.

An error has occurred

The application failed to start.

The application exited during initialization.

Error in dyn.load(file, DLLpath = DLLpath, ...) : unable to load shared object '/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/httpuv/libs/httpuv.so': libRcpp.so: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘shiny’ Execution halted
